title: Narra 4.1.11
message: Update checking now responds clearly and always uses the current official release channel.
changelog: Check for updates now always shows checking, up-to-date, update-ready, or connection feedback.
Manual checks bypass stale manifest caches so the result reflects the current release channel.
Invalid or incompatible release information is reported clearly instead of making the button appear inactive.
The APK, Profile page, and updater now agree on Narra 4.1.11 build 17.
